latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Release Notes Humanizer skill.
- Converts raw git logs, PR lists, or changelog drafts into polished, audience-targeted release notes.
- Detects and categorizes changes (new, improved, fixed, breaking, removed), filtering internal and irrelevant details.
- Rewrites updates from an end-user benefit perspective, grouping and prioritizing by user value.
- Supports output for multiple audiences: in-app changelog, emails, developer notes, marketing, and status-page formats.
- Adapts tone and templates to match styles from notable companies (Linear, Stripe, Vercel, Figma, Tailwind, Notion).
